# ShramkoGSFPV

> Open-source (MIT) browser FPV drone simulator for 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes. Fly any public SuperSplat scan with a quadcopter model (4 motors, mixer, rate PID, Betaflight/Actual/KISS/Raceflight rate curves), swept voxel collision with real crashes, and your EdgeTX radio over WebHID, a gamepad or touch sticks. WebGPU + PlayCanvas. Author: Andrii Shramko. Live at https://gsfpv.flyreelstudio.eu (alpha, September 2026).

Key facts (measured, see the JSON files in evidence/2026-09-24/):
- Rate curves match Betaflight 4.5.1's own rc.c at 1880 points with 0 deg/s error, both computed in double precision; a float32 build differs by at most 6.3e-4 deg/s.
- 0 wall pass-throughs in 200,000 straight passes at 5-34 m/s (1 ms swept test vs an independent oracle): 150,000 on three real scans, 50,000 at a 2 cm wall.
- The whole flight is deterministic: the SHA-256 of the trace is identical in Node and Chrome and across 30/60/144/240 Hz frame splits; replays are recomputed from stick inputs only.
- Scenes load in the visitor's browser straight from the public SuperSplat CDN; the server never contacts SuperSplat.
- Default craft: BetaFPV Pavo20 Pro class 2.2-inch cinewhoop, plus five more BetaFPV-class whoops (Pavo20 Pro II 3S and 4S, Pavo Pico, Meteor65 Pro, Air65) and, since v0.8, three open-prop drones for big scans: an iFlight Nazgul Evoque F5 class 5-inch freestyle quad, an iFlight Mach R5 Sport class 5-inch race quad and an iFlight Taurus X8 class cinelifter carrying a RED Komodo (4.9 kg, with prop wash). The spec rows on each preset card (thrust-to-weight, weight, wheelbase, motor, battery) are labelled manufacturer / measured / estimate; the card's maximum rate and hover throttle (full pack and near empty) are computed by the model. Pilots who fly one of these drones for real can send a Drone physics report from the simulator (Help tune it: what feels different, Betaflight diff all, a blackbox log link) to refine it, or ask for a drone that is missing.
- Radio support has been tested in desktop Chrome with a simulated EdgeTX radio; a real radio, Edge, gamepads and the DJI controller have not been tested yet.
- Touch sticks were tested only in desktop Chrome's touch emulation (375x812, 1024x768): arming, both sticks at once and the pause button work, but holding a hover was not checked and the check's negative control is not conclusive yet. Safari, iPad and Android browsers have not been tested yet.
- Firefox 155 renders the scene with WebGPU and offers a gamepad or touch sticks; radios need Chrome or Edge (no WebHID in Firefox).
- Crash effects stay under the WCAG limit of 3 flashes per second (at most 2 per second measured over 50 crashes).
- Gravity: Earth and Moon drops measured; Mars, zero-g, a custom value and the keep-thrust-to-weight mode are not tested yet.

## Links
- [Simulator and landing page](https://gsfpv.flyreelstudio.eu): fly in the browser, EN/ES/PL/RU
- [Scene pages](https://gsfpv.flyreelstudio.eu/scenes/llms.txt): every place in the catalogue with its own page in four languages (facts of the 3D scan, author and licence, walls, wind, a link that opens it in the simulator); the catalogue page is https://gsfpv.flyreelstudio.eu/en/scenes/
- [README](https://github.com/AndriiShramko/ShramkoGSFPV/blob/main/README.md): what it is, measured numbers, FAQ, contacts
- [AGENT_SETUP.md](https://github.com/AndriiShramko/ShramkoGSFPV/blob/main/AGENT_SETUP.md): install, update and remove with a coding agent
- [Decisions](https://github.com/AndriiShramko/ShramkoGSFPV/blob/main/docs/decisions.md): architecture choices and reasons
- [Warnings](https://github.com/AndriiShramko/ShramkoGSFPV/blob/main/docs/warnings.md): risks and limits, stated honestly
- [Provenance](https://github.com/AndriiShramko/ShramkoGSFPV/blob/main/docs/PROVENANCE.md): where every piece of code came from
- [Settings catalogue](https://github.com/AndriiShramko/ShramkoGSFPV/blob/main/docs/settings.md): every setting of the simulator with its default, range, scope and keyboard key: 64 settings in 11 groups, 30 keyboard keys, 9 drone presets and 5 rate-curve types (generated from the settings schema at each release; in four languages at https://gsfpv.flyreelstudio.eu/en/#tune)
